name: Math Race
tagline: Same equation, a clock, first correct scores. Invite is the room — no game server.
description:
An equation pops up. Type the answer. The first person who gets it scores, and the next one is already there. The clock is running — pick 30, 60, or 90 seconds.

On your own it is you against the clock, on this device. Easy is plus and minus of small numbers; medium is times tables; hard mixes them. Your best score lives in the file. Close it, come back, try to beat it.

Press Play a friend, then Invite in the bar above the app. The same equations land on both phones at once. Live scores. When the clock hits zero, the round is over. There is no game server and no account — the invite is the room, and the file is the save.

A wrong answer does not freeze you. It flashes, and you stay on the same equation. Try again.

An unofficial port of math-race by iloire. The original needed you to host a game server (the public demo is gone). This copy does not.
